note.en: Check a hyperbolic-function continuum solution on the lower branch and mesh refinement. Follow-on sensitivity/inverse examples validate derivatives and objectives separately. This metadata registration is not a new execution.

name.en: 1D Bratu: Newton–GMRES on the lower branch

note.ja: 解析解 既存の残差十分減少による減衰NewtonとILU(0)付きGMRES。解析解u=2log[cosh(β/2)/cosh(β(x−1/2))]。βtanh(β/2)<2で小さい枝を選び、初期値は全点零。内部Newton制御は非線形許容値1e-10、最大30反復。 既存の固定入力・保存結果に対応する解析参照カードを追加。解析式、点・時刻・動径の標本化、配布版SHAと実行コードを相互に辿れます。過去の計算を再実行した記録ではありません。
note.en: Analytic reference Existing residual-decrease damped Newton and ILU(0)-GMRES. Analytic u=2log[cosh(β/2)/cosh(β(x−1/2))]. βtanh(β/2)<2 selects the lower branch and all initial unknowns are zero. Nonlinear tolerance is 1e-10 with at most 30 Newton iterations. An analytic reference card now links the existing fixed inputs and saved results: formula, point/time/radial sampling, edition SHA and executable code. This metadata registration is not a new execution.
